A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show that the best previous bound for the space complexity of a choice dictionary can be improved to $n+1+o(n)$ bits.
we have improved the best known space bounds for all operations of choice dictionaries.
we provide the first constant time uncolored and colored choice dictionaries with optimal space usage, which are optimal even if the word length of the word RAM is unbounded.
